say:1:1260007001:0.text: After defeating the monsters, they, just like before, quickly shed their twisted forms and revert to humans.
say:1:1260007001:0.source_cn: 击倒了怪物后，它们果然如前一般，开始迅速褪去扭曲的外表...

say:2:1260007002:0.text: Only this time, the victims seemed unusually energetic.
say:2:1260007002:0.source_cn: 只是，这次的受害者，格外生龙活虎。

say:5:1260007004:1.text: Agh—uh, huh? What happened? Why did I suddenly just...
say:5:1260007004:1.source_cn: 嗷——呃、呃啊？怎么回事？我刚刚怎么突然就……

say:6:1260007005:1.text: Wow, they really did turn back...
say:6:1260007005:1.source_cn: 哇，竟、竟然真的变回来了……

say:7:1260007006:1.text: See, I told you, a good thrashing would fix them, just like when we turned into rats!
say:7:1260007006:1.source_cn: 看，我就说，找人揍他们一顿就能复原，和之前咱们被变成老...

say:10:1260007007:1.text: Ah... I feel like I had a really satisfying dream. Had a big ruckus and taught those Water Wight fools a good lesson—
say:10:1260007007:1.source_cn: 呼……啊。感觉做了个很爽快的梦。大闹了一场，狠狠教训了...

say:14:1260007009:0.text: Ow, ow, ow! Lucca, why did you hit me? I've been behaving and haven't fought at all today.
say:14:1260007009:0.source_cn: 呜哇，疼疼疼！二当家，干嘛突然打我？今天我可老老实实地...

say:17:1260007010:1.text: Who says! You were actual monsters just now, and you attacked us! Even I'm banged up!
say:17:1260007010:1.source_cn: 谁说的！你们刚才是活生生的怪物，见了我们就直接就往脸上...

say:26:1260007013:1.text: ...You all need to clear your heads. I have some questions.
say:26:1260007013:1.source_cn: ……你们都清醒清醒，我有话要问。

say:27:1260007014:1.text: Darlo, before you turned into monsters, did you see a female Graveborn?
say:27:1260007014:1.source_cn: 达里洛，你们在变成怪物之前，有没有见过一个亡灵女性。

say:33:1260007016:0.text: Was she a Graveborn? I'm not sure... At the time, the Bear and the Bobcat were discussing how to deal with the Water Wights. I wanted to greet them...
say:33:1260007016:0.source_cn: 是亡灵吗？我不确定……当时暴熊和山猫大哥在商量怎么找水...

say:34:1260007017:0.text: Just behind them, I spotted a stunning woman—dressed in black with hair as dark as the night!
say:34:1260007017:0.source_cn: 在他们身后不远处，我瞧见一个非常漂亮的妹子——黑衣黑裙...

say:37:1260007018:1.text: Oh? You must work for the top dog around here. I believe I saw you yesterday.
say:37:1260007018:1.source_cn: ………哦？是本地主人的部下吧？昨天似乎看到过你们。

say:38:1260007019:1.text: What a rough bunch... but your energy and enthusiasm are quite fascinating.
say:38:1260007019:1.source_cn: 虽然是些粗野的家伙，但是这份活力和热血倒是颇有趣味……

say:39:1260007020:0.text: Well then, put on a show for me.

say:41:1260007021:0.text: She appeared abruptly before us and said some baffling things, but at that moment, my mind went blank, and I could only stare at her.
say:41:1260007021:0.source_cn: 她非常突兀地出现在我们面前，说了些莫名其妙的话，但，我...

say:42:1260007022:1.text: The two others were also frozen, just staring at her, forgetting what they were supposed to do!
say:42:1260007022:1.source_cn: 当时两位大哥也僵住了，直勾勾地盯着她，都忘记了要干什么！

say:44:1260007023:0.text: Y-yes, in hindsight, her skin and eyes were quite strange... but at the time, I didn't feel anything unusual.
say:44:1260007023:0.source_cn: 是、是啊，明明回想起来，她的肤色和眼睛都很异常……可那...

say:45:1260007024:0.text: I only thought she was extremely beautiful and dignified, even feeling an urge to bow to her...
say:45:1260007024:0.source_cn: 只是觉得非常漂亮，而且很有威严，甚至忍不住想对她行礼……

say:46:1260007025:0.text: I almost did too... but then, I just blacked out.
say:46:1260007025:0.source_cn: 我也差一点就……但紧接着，我就失去意识了。

say:48:1260007026:0.source_cn: ……听起来是她，那个叫瑟西娅的亡灵。

say:49:1260007027:1.text: Unexpectedly, Sonja apologizes to the victims before her—both to the Carmine Whispers and the Water Wights.
say:49:1260007027:1.source_cn: 随即，出乎所有人意料，索尼娅对着眼前的受害者们致歉——...

say:50:1260007028:1.text: Everyone, due to our previous oversight, we were unable to stop her in time.
say:50:1260007028:1.source_cn: 各位兄弟，由于我们此前的疏失，没能及时阻拦她的行动。

say:51:1260007029:1.text: I promise to bolster our forces and strengthen the city's defenses.
say:51:1260007029:1.source_cn: 我们会加派人手，加强城内的守备。

say:54:1260007030:1.text: Uh, ah, no need to be so polite... it's giving me the creeps.
say:54:1260007030:1.source_cn: 呃，啊，不用这么客气吧……搞得背后毛毛的。

say:57:1260007031:1.text: Agreed, while I'd love to see the leader of the Carmine Whispers bowing to me, um, let's just skip ahead.
say:57:1260007031:1.source_cn: 是啊，虽说我是挺想看血薇帮的头头对我毕恭毕敬，但，呃，...

say:58:1260007032:1.text: We were the ones who got ambushed first, and honestly, turning into rats was actually pretty exciting...
say:58:1260007032:1.source_cn: 本来就是我们最先遭了暗算，再说，那时候变成耗子，其实，...

say:61:1260007033:1.text: Just say "it's fine." These lot are too focused on their pride.
say:61:1260007033:1.source_cn: 直接说“没关系”就好了，两位大哥太要面子了……

say:64:1260007034:1.text: The idiots from the Water Wights don't know what's good for them. Just ignore them, boss!
say:64:1260007034:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮的蠢货就是不知好歹，别搭理他们了，当家的！

say:65:1260007035:1.text: Even if we all changed, being Graveborn is still better than being one of those idiots who turned into rats!
say:65:1260007035:1.source_cn: 就算都是变化，我们变成亡灵，也比有些变成耗子的蠢货要强！

say:68:1260007036:1.text: Don't get me wrong, though Graveborns aren't exactly pleasant, the feeling of being one was pretty nice—my whole body felt relaxed and full of energy... like I could keep fighting and taking hits.
say:68:1260007036:1.source_cn: 你别说，虽然亡灵不是什么好东西，但当亡灵的滋味还不错，...

say:71:1260007037:1.text: After all, for some people, their brains are barely functioning to begin with, so becoming a mindless Graveborn just puts them further in their element.
say:71:1260007037:1.source_cn: 毕竟有的人脑子就聊胜于无，变成没有脑子的亡灵之后那不就...

say:73:1260007039:1.text: You can still understand human speech and seem more reasonable now. How about you try turning into a rat? It might make you smarter.
say:73:1260007039:1.source_cn: 还能听得懂人话，看起来更通人性了，你要不要也变个耗子试...

say:74:1260007040:1.text: This is infuriating! I'd rather turn into a Graveborn and teach you a lesson!
say:74:1260007040:1.source_cn: 哇啊啊啊啊啊！气死我了！我还不如变成亡灵，好给你一点颜...

choice_prompt:75:1260007040.text: This is infuriating! I'd rather turn into a Graveborn and teach you a lesson!
choice_prompt:75:1260007040.source_cn: 哇啊啊啊啊啊！气死我了！我还不如变成亡灵，好给你一点颜色看看！

say:76:1260007041:1.text: Hm, I know... in that in-between state of neither human nor ghost, the only perk is strength. I wish I could switch at any time.
say:76:1260007041:1.source_cn: 呃唔，我也知道……那人不人鬼不鬼的样子，只有力气说得过...
say:76:1260007041:1.male: Hm, I know... in that in-between state of neither human nor ghost, the only perk is strength. I wish I could switch at any time.
say:76:1260007041:1.female: Hm, I know... in that in-between state of neither human nor ghost, the only perk is strength. I wish I could switch at any time.

say:79:1260007043:1.text: If it's merely a shapeshifting spell, it's quite simple for Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:79:1260007043:1.source_cn: 如果只是幻形魔法的话，对<style=stress><...
say:79:1260007043:1.male: If it's merely a shapeshifting spell, it's quite simple for Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:79:1260007043:1.female: If it's merely a shapeshifting spell, it's quite simple for Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:80:1260007044:1.text: He has this handsome face now thanks to the shapeshifting spell.
say:80:1260007044:1.male: He has this handsome face now thanks to the shapeshifting spell.
say:80:1260007044:1.female: She has this beautiful face now thanks to the shapeshifting spell.

say:83:1260007045:0.text: However, that's vastly different from what you just experienced! You became monsters, from bones to muscles.
say:83:1260007045:0.source_cn: 不过，那和你们刚才经历的完全不同！你们刚才是从骨头到肌...

say:84:1260007046:1.text: The Magister's magic merely alters your appearance, leaving your mind unchanged.
say:84:1260007046:1.source_cn: 主人的魔法，只会让外形上看起来是另一种模样，你们的思维...
say:84:1260007046:1.male: The Magister's magic merely alters your appearance, leaving your mind unchanged.
say:84:1260007046:1.female: The Magister's magic merely alters your appearance, leaving your mind unchanged.

say:85:1260007047:1.text: At this moment, accompanied by the rhythmic clanging of metal, a familiar voice draws near—
say:85:1260007047:1.source_cn: 这时，伴随着有节奏的铁器撞击声，一个熟悉的声音由远及近——

say:88:1260007048:1.text: Ha! You finally remembered the Fall Harvest tradition! I heard you talking about disguises—what are you planning to dress up as?
say:88:1260007048:1.source_cn: 嚯哈哈哈，你们终于想起来秋夜节的传统了！我听到你们在说...

say:92:1260007050:1.text: What, weren't you organizing the Fall Harvest? Last time we parted, you said you needed to get it done quickly.
say:92:1260007050:1.source_cn: 什么，你们不是在筹办秋夜节吗？上次分别的时候，你还说要...

say:93:1260007051:1.text: Yes, but we were interrupted by the sudden appearance of a Graveborn.
say:93:1260007051:1.source_cn: 是，但那时被突然出现的亡灵打断了。

say:94:1260007052:1.text: And what now? You've simply forgotten about the Fall Harvest?
say:94:1260007052:1.source_cn: 然后呢？你们就干脆把秋夜节抛之脑后了？

say:95:1260007053:1.text: I feared your lack of experience, so I drafted the plans last night for your first event!
say:95:1260007053:1.source_cn: 我担心你们第一次办，没经验，趁昨晚都把计划书列好了！

say:98:1260007054:1.text: Uh, is it really time for the festival now...?
say:98:1260007054:1.source_cn: 呃，现在，是过节的时候吗……？

say:99:1260007055:1.text: What do you know! This is a precious tradition. The Fall Harvest was originally held to commemorate fallen warriors after the end of the Divine War.
say:99:1260007055:1.source_cn: 年轻的家伙，你懂什么！这是宝贵的传统习俗，秋夜节诞生之...

say:100:1260007056:1.text: On this day, everyone gathers together to honor the spirits of the fallen heroes throughout the night. To show the camaraderie and unity from the wars, every Fall Harvest has some form of costume tradition.
say:100:1260007056:1.source_cn: 在这一日，各个族裔齐聚一堂，彻夜怀念着逝去的英灵，为了...

say:101:1260007057:1.text: The traditions of the Fall Harvest have been passed down for thousands of years! We can't just abandon them now!
say:101:1260007057:1.source_cn: 秋夜节的传统都流传上千年了，怎么能在咱们这一代说断就断掉？！

say:104:1260007058:1.text: So, uh, are we celebrating the festival now? Amidst the chaos in the city with Graveborns and monsters everywhere?
say:104:1260007058:1.source_cn: 那，呃，我们，要在这时候过节？要在城里大乱，亡灵和怪物...

say:105:1260007059:1.text: Exactly, this is the perfect time! Originally, the Fall Harvest was held to honor the spirits all night, but it gradually turned into a night of costume revelry.
say:105:1260007059:1.source_cn: 就是要趁这个时候！最早的秋夜节是为了彻夜怀念英灵，但慢...

say:106:1260007060:1.text: To this day, it's said that on the night of the Fall Harvest, even the spirits of the departed are granted return to the mortal realm. They take on different forms, mingling with the crowds to sing and dance.
say:106:1260007060:1.source_cn: 流传至今，据说到了秋夜节当晚，死神也会允许逝去的英灵回...

say:107:1260007061:1.text: In the midst of the city's turmoil, it's the perfect way to bolster everyone's spirits.
say:107:1260007061:1.source_cn: 城里大乱，正好用这个理由安抚人心。

say:108:1260007062:1.text: The commemorative aspect is indeed fitting for the ailing Rustport... and it provides a means to suppress rumors of people turning into monsters.
say:108:1260007062:1.source_cn: 这个纪念意义确实很适合如今百废待兴的锈锚港……而且可以...

say:109:1260007063:1.text: Hugin, I will send others to help you advance the Fall Harvest plans. However, Cecia cannot be left ignored.
say:109:1260007063:1.source_cn: 呼金，我会派人协助你推进秋夜节的筹办计划。但那个名叫瑟...

say:110:1260007064:1.text: Before the festival arrives, we must stop her.
say:110:1260007064:1.source_cn: 在庆典到来前，我们必须阻止她。

narration:111:1260007065:1.text: Meanwhile, in a tranquil and deserted corner...
narration:111:1260007065:1.source_cn: 同一时刻，某个幽静无人的角落……

say:113:1260007066:1.text: It seems that even with the life force extracted from the Lucent Tree, it's impossible to sustain the fleshweave spell for long.
say:113:1260007066:1.source_cn: 看来就算有从流荧树那里抽取的生命力，也无法长久维系血肉魔法。

say:114:1260007067:1.text: To create a new generation of our kind, the Void Relic of Bantus remains essential.
say:114:1260007067:1.source_cn: 为了让全新的我族诞生，班题斯圣器仍然必不可少。

say:115:1260007068:1.text: How could such a valuable relic be discarded at the bottom of the sea? Can the locals not grasp its worth, or do they understand that its power is too dangerous to control?
say:115:1260007068:1.source_cn: 竟然将那般珍贵的圣物弃置于海底，是这里的庶民不明白它的...

say:118:1260007071:1.text: How dull... It would have been better if you had retained your ability to speak.
say:118:1260007071:1.source_cn: ……真是无趣。要是保留你的语言能力就好了。

say:119:1260007072:1.text: Nevertheless, you willingly accepted becoming like this, didn't you?
say:119:1260007072:1.source_cn: 不过，变成这样，也是你心甘情愿，对么？

say:120:1260007073:1.text: The servant slowly raises a foot, stepping on the stone slabs with a muffled sound.
say:120:1260007073:1.source_cn: 无名的仆人缓缓抬起一只脚，踏响地上的石板砖，发出一声闷响。

say:122:1260007075:1.text: Well then, it's time for the next act.

say:124:1260007042:1.text: Is there magic that could transform us? I'd love to try it if it could make me stronger!
say:124:1260007042:1.source_cn: 有能变成其他形态的魔法？我倒是想试试，能把我变得更强壮吗？！
say:124:1260007042:1.male: Is there magic that could transform us? I'd love to try it if it could make me stronger!
say:124:1260007042:1.female: Is there magic that could transform us? I'd love to try it if it could make me stronger!

choice:75:1:2.text: I have a safe morphing spell.
choice:75:1:2.male: I have a safe morphing spell.
choice:75:1:2.female: I have a safe morphing spell.
